PopupAnnouncement.en-US:
Dear valued agents,
We wish to announce the launching of our new product – Poker with effect from 18/07/2012, by default all settings will be configured as follows:
No position taking offered for Poker product.
No currency play, otherwise, agents shall bear the risk and loss.
Should you wish to have different settings for your downlines, please go to Poker setting page. Thanks

扑克没有占成设定。
若任何代理层在此玩家对玩中使用自设兑换率或倍数将自负其所带来与造成的风险和损失。
若您需要更改下线设定，请到下线名单中点击修改扑克。谢谢
